facts.fact: 骑士（Knight of Swords）有把信息武器化的前科：她曾把凡人本不该施放的咒语交给 Wilcox 的 coven。
facts.anchor: After all, she’d already proven herself capable of weaponizing information when she’d given Wilcox’s coven spells that mortals should never have been casting.

facts.fact: 她的儿子 North 是 half human（半人类），这意味着他很可能会像凡人一样受生魔法（raw magic）伤害。
facts.anchor: North was half human, which meant he likely shared a mortal’s vulnerability to raw magic.

facts.fact: 骑士向 Adam 说明来意：North 变得孤僻，她觉得他可能孤独，请 Adam 去和他说说话。
facts.anchor: “I am here because North has become withdrawn. I think he may be lonely. Would you speak with him?”

facts.fact: Adam 谢绝把这次拜访当交易筹码：『我是为 North 做的，你可以把它当作一份白给的礼物。』
facts.anchor: “No,” he said. “I’m doing it for North. You may consider it a gift, freely given.”

facts.fact: Dautre 施展传送术，一眨眼把 Adam 从 Denver 送到灵界、再带回地球（North 的宅邸）。
facts.anchor: He brought them from Denver to the spirit realm and back to earth in a blink.

facts.fact: North 交代秘密收藏的来历：母亲用 glamour 挡住凡人（看不见房子、无法靠近），他通常趁夜里溜出去搜捡东西。
facts.anchor: Mother has glamours to keep them away, but I sneak out, usually at night, to see what I can find.

facts.fact: North 的魔法不稳定：glamour 会『直接滑落』，或在 a few minutes（几分钟）后碎裂，甚至会伤到他。
facts.anchor: “They slide right off,” he said sadly. “Or they break after a few minutes. They can even hurt me.”

facts.fact: 临别 Adam 才意识到：刚才 North 拥抱他时，自己并没有退缩。
facts.anchor: It was only when he spotted him that he realized he hadn’t flinched when North had hugged him.
